opening.argument: The title presents Forsage as a system for working and earning, expressly inviting viewers to pursue income through the program. The demonstrated interface reinforces that invitation with separate paid upgrades for additional program levels, including xXx and xGold at 15 BUSD and 20 BUSD. Alongside the displayed profit figures, partner and team growth, and personal referral links, these tiered payments frame participation as dependent on expanding a multi-person matrix and upgrading within it.

citations.quote: How To Work On Forsage || How To Earn From Forsage
